auditNote: Visual audit of GEMELS.pdf (720 pages) via rendered page images (poppler + PyMuPDF). Method: (1) read all range-overview pages (PDF p23-43) in full detail — these enumerate the complete product range with catalog page references; (2) contact-sheet sweep of every 4th body page (PDF p44-692, each series spans 4+ pages so no series could be skipped) checking every section header against the 100 extracted products. Result: 2 series were MISSED by the text-only extraction, both hydraulic ball valves with SAE J518 flange-head (C61/C62) ends: GES (catalog p384-387, PDF p386-389) and GBS (catalog p414-417, PDF p416-419). Likely cause: their tables sit directly after the visually similar GEF and GBF sections (the extracted GEF entry's sourcePages '382-389' actually spans the GES pages) and the range overview lists them in a right-hand column easily conflated with GE5/GEF-S/GBF-S in plain text. Everything else was confirmed complete: all 32 quick-coupling series, all remaining hydraulic ball valves (incl. GE5 vs GES disambiguated visually), hydraulic valves (incl. VBP sub-variants VBPSE/VBPDE covered by the single VBP entry), swivel joints, oil & gas ball valves (GN/GN HC/GM/SBF/SBF-W/SBT/DBB), electric motors, and kits (locking, handles, pneumatic/electric actuators J4C-JDA-JSR-DA-SR, limit switch). Pages 694-720 are technical reference only (no products). Both new products reuse the existing gemels-ball-valves category and its spec keys; no new categories needed.

products.shortDescriptionEn: 2-way high pressure ball valve with integrated SAE J518 flange heads (C61/C62), DN13 to DN25, up to 420 bar
products.descriptionKo: 밸브 양단에 SAE J518 플랜지 헤드가 일체로 가공된 2웨이 고압 볼 밸브입니다. S3000(C61, 35MPa)과 S6000(C62, 42MPa) 압력 클래스를 지원하며 사이즈는 DN13~DN25입니다. 스플릿 플랜지 클램프로 배관에 직결할 수 있어 별도 어댑터가 필요 없고, 표준형 외에 엑스트라 롱(연장형) 버전도 제공됩니다. 탄소강(1.0737, 아연 도금)과 스테인리스강(1.4404) 사양이 있으며 카본강 밸브에는 고정 홀이 기본 포함됩니다.
products.descriptionEn: A 2-way high pressure ball valve with SAE J518 flange heads machined integrally on both ends, for direct split-flange clamping to the line without adapters. Available in S3000 (C61, 35 MPa) and S6000 (C62, 42 MPa) pressure classes, sizes DN13 to DN25, in standard and extra-long body versions. Offered in galvanized carbon steel (1.0737) and stainless steel (1.4404); fixing holes are included on carbon steel valves.

products.descriptionEn: A forged-body 2-way high pressure ball valve for larger bores (DN32 to DN50) with SAE J518 flange heads machined integrally on both ends for direct split-flange clamping. Available in S3000 (C61: 28 MPa at DN32, 21 MPa at DN40/DN50) and S6000 (C62: 42 MPa all sizes) pressure classes, in standard and extra-long body versions, in galvanized carbon steel (body 1.0570) or stainless steel (1.4404).
